docs.title: DocManaga Developer Portal
docs.text:
Welcome to the DocManaga Developer Platform.

DocManaga provides a secure document management API that allows businesses to store, manage, and share documents programmatically.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Upload and store documents
  • Secure document sharing
  • Password protection
  • Merge multiple documents
  • Download and manage files

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: This guide helps you start using the DocManaga API.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
All API requests require an API key.

Example header:

Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

docs.title: Use Cases
docs.text: The DocManaga API allows developers to build applications that securely store, manage, and share documents. Below are common ways businesses can use the DocManaga platform.

docs.title: Secure Document Storage
docs.text:
Businesses can use the DocManaga API to automatically upload and store important documents such as invoices, contracts, and reports.

For example, a financial application may generate invoices and automatically store them using the Upload Document API.

docs.title: Example Workflow
docs.text:
1. The application generates a PDF invoice.
  2. The application uploads the document using the Upload Document API.
  3. The API returns a document ID.
  4. The document can later be retrieved using the Get Document API.

docs.title: Secure Document Sharing
docs.text:
Businesses can share documents with external users or clients by generating shareable links using the Share Document API.

This is useful for distributing contracts, reports, or any document that needs to be accessed by parties outside the platform.

docs.title: Example Workflow
docs.text:
1. A document is uploaded and stored in DocManaga.
  2. The application calls the Share Document API with the document ID.
  3. The API returns a shareable link.
  4. The link is distributed to the intended recipient.

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Parameter Type Description id string Unique document ID

docs.title: Get All Documents
docs.text: Returns a list of all documents stored in the user's account.

docs.title: Description
docs.text: This endpoint retrieves all documents available in the authenticated account.

docs.title: Merge Documents
docs.text: Merges multiple documents into a single file.

docs.title: Share Document
docs.text: Generates a shareable link for a document.

docs.title: Upload Document
docs.text: Uploads a document file to DocManaga storage.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
All requests to the DocManaga API must be authenticated using an API key.

Authentication ensures that only authorized users can access and manage documents stored in the DocManaga platform.

docs.title: API Keys
docs.text:
When you create a DocManaga developer account, you are issued a unique API key. This key must be included in every request made to the API.

Your API key should be treated as a secret and never exposed publicly.

docs.title: Authorization Header
docs.text:
The API key is sent using the Authorization header in the following format:

Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

docs.title: Security
docs.text: Security is a core component of the DocManaga platform. The API provides several features that help protect sensitive documents and ensure secure access.

docs.title: Password Protection
docs.text:
Developers can protect documents by assigning a password using the Protect Document API.

This feature ensures that only users with the correct password can access the document.

docs.title: Secure Document Sharing
docs.text:
The Share Document API allows developers to generate shareable links that can be distributed to external users.

Share links can include expiration settings to limit access duration.

docs.title: API Key Protection
docs.text:
To prevent unauthorized access:

  • Never expose API keys publicly
  • Store keys in secure environments
  • Use server-side requests whenever possible

docs.title: Encryption
docs.text:
DocManaga ensures documents are encrypted both:

  • In transit using HTTPS
  • At rest within the storage infrastructure

docs.title: Recommended Security Practices
docs.text:
To maximize security when using the API:

  • Implement secure key storage
  • Monitor API usage
  • Regularly audit access permissions
  • Rotate credentials when necessary

docs.title: Uploading Files
docs.text:
DocManaga allows developers to upload and store documents programmatically using the Upload Document API.

This functionality enables businesses to automate document management workflows such as storing invoices, contracts, reports, and other files.
